plugin.name: BF Dremora Adults
plugin.description: Beeing Female NG add-on. Makes Dremora children (vanilla and Dragonborn/DLC2 Dremora) grow into Dark Elf adults - the closest vanilla lookalike - using the Adult Pack bases that ship with Beeing Female NG, so no extra mods are needed. Shows up on the BF MCM AddOn page (Race section), enabled. Requires Beeing Female NG.
